svg.text: Lab 4: the Minikube topology. Two services, one registry, one dashboard, the answering model outside
Minikube cluster, namespace mlops (Kubernetes 1.30, docker driver, 4 GB)
holds the numbers of a job
Images are built inside minikube and pulled by name:tag (IfNotPresent).
Prometheus scrapes /metrics of ml-service and llm-service by cluster DNS.
